datasets.name: Main
datasets.sql:
select p.id,p.numberofcredit,
 CM_COMMON.accountnumber_get(a.LOANACCID)      as "Ssuda hes",
 CM_COMMON.accountnumber_get(a.INTERESTACCID)  as "Faiz hes",
 CM_COMMON.accountnumber_get(a.DUELOANACCID)   as "Gej Ssuda hes",
 CM_COMMON.accountnumber_get(a.DUEINTERESTACCID)as " Gej Faiz hes",
 CM_COMMON.accountnumber_get(a.PRIMARYRESERVEACCID)as "Ehtiyyat hes",
 CM_COMMON.accountnumber_get(a.SECONDARYRESERVEACCID)as "Gej Ehtiyyat hes",
 CM_COMMON.accountnumber_get(a.BOOROWERACCID)as "Jari hes",
 p.creditlineamount , p.creditlineamount*o.ostat as ekvalent,v.val_name,
 cu.name as borcalan, t.description,  p.dateofconclusion,p.duedatefirstcontract,p.duedatelastcontract,
  CM_PURDENSAL.get_duerest(p.id) as vaxtibitmish,
  CM_PURDENSAL.get_duedat(p.id) as hesablanmayan , p.annualyinterestrate,p.annualyoverduerate,
  case when r.PERCENT<=10
  then  (r.PERCENT*ds.rest)/100 else 0 end as adi,--pt.description,
  case when r.PERCENT>10
  then (r.PERCENT *ds.rest)/100 else 0 end as meqsedli,
ds.rest as ds_rest,ds.rest*o.ostat as dsrest_ek,ds.interestrest as dsinterestrest,ds.interestrest*o.ostat as dsint_ek,ds.duerest as dsduerest,ds.duerest*o.ostat as dsduerest_ek ,
ds.dueinterestrest as dsdueinterestrest ,ds.dueinterestrest * o.ostat as dsdoeint_ek,
pl.description,ds.pledgeprice,g.PLEDGENAME,  case when cu.nerezident=0  then 'Rezdent'  else 'Qeyri rezdent' end as rezdent,
CM_RPORT.get_vid_sob(p.activities_type)as "Mulkiyyet novu",cm_RPORT.get_aim(p.aim_id) as "Kreditin alunma meqsedi",CM_RPORT.get_cred(p.creditact) as "Borcalanun sektoru",CM_RPORT.get_actives(p.activities) as "Borcalanin faliyyeti",
ca.description  as "Borcalanin faliyyet novu" ,(ds.interestrest+ds.dueinterestrest)as "faizler uzre borclar",
(ds.interestrest+ds.dueinterestrest)*o.ostat as "Faizler uzre borclar ek" ,(ds.rest+ds.duerest) as "Cari borclar" ,(ds.rest+ds.duerest)*o.ostat as "Cari borclar EK",
CM_UTILS.Get_Gecgun(p.id,:dat) as gecgun ,
case when gd.dueday between 1 and 30 then
ds.rest+ds.duerest else 0 end as "1 30",
case when gd.dueday between 31 and 60 then
ds.rest+ds.duerest else 0 end as "31-60",
case when gd.dueday between 61 and 90 then
ds.rest+ds.duerest else 0 end as "61-90",
case when gd.dueday between 91 and 120 then
ds.rest+ds.duerest else 0 end as "91-120",
case when gd.dueday between 121 and 150 then
ds.rest+ds.duerest else 0 end as "121-150",
case when gd.dueday between 151 and 180 then
ds.rest+ds.duerest else 0 end as "151-180",
case when gd.dueday between 181 and 210 then
ds.rest+ds.duerest else 0 end as "181-210",
case when gd.dueday between 211 and 240 then
ds.rest+ds.duerest else 0 end as "211-240",
case when gd.dueday between 241 and 270 then
ds.rest+ds.duerest else 0 end as "241-270",
case when gd.dueday between 271 and 300 then
ds.rest+ds.duerest else 0 end as "271-300",
case when gd.dueday between 301 and 330 then
ds.rest+ds.duerest else 0 end as "301-330",
case when gd.dueday between 331 and 365 then
ds.rest+ds.duerest else 0 end as "331-365",
case when gd.dueday >=366 then
ds.rest+ds.duerest else 0 end as "Bir ilden artiq"

 from
 cm_active_credits p,cm_reserve_types r,  cm_history ds, smart.customers cu,cm_categories ca,
cm_accounts a,operkurs o,smart.avalute v ,cm_credittypes t,cm_guarantee g,cm_pledges pl,CM_DUEDAY gd --,CM_PLEDGES_T pt
 where
/* p.id=h.creditid and */p.id=ds.creditid and gd.creditid=p.id and
 /*h.hdate=(select tek_dat from smart.sysdat) and*/
 p.id=a.creditid and p.customertype=ca.id and --g.PLEDGEID_P=pt.id and 
 p.currency=o.VAL_KOD and
o.DAT=:dat and
p.currency=v.valute and ds.rest+ds.duerest+ds.interestrest>0 and
p.credittype=t.id and
r.id=ds.reserveid and ds.hdate =:dat and
p.id=g.creditid(+) and g.PLEDGEID=pl.id(+) and p.boorowerid=cu.id  --and p.usrgroup not in(84,85,104,105)

datasets.name: CemSet
datasets.sql:
SELECT code,name,m_kodu,"Mulkiyyet novu", kodu as s_kodu ,"Borcalanun sektoru",VAL_NAME,
       a_kodu as f_kodu, "Borcalanin faliyyeti",p_kodu as fn_kodu, "Borcalanin faliyyet novu",
       sum(creditlineamount), sum(ekvalent), /*sum(vaxtibitmish),*/ sum(hesablanmayan),
       sum(adi), sum(meqsedli), sum(ds_rest), sum(dsrest_ek), sum(dsinterestrest),
       sum(dsint_ek), sum(dsduerest), sum(dsduerest_ek), sum(dsdueinterestrest),
       sum(dsdoeint_ek), /*sum(pledgeprice),*/ sum("faizler uzre borclar"),
       sum("Faizler uzre borclar ek"),sum( "Cari borclar"),
       sum("Cari borclar EK"),  sum("1-30"),sum("31-60"),
       sum("61-90"), sum("91-120"), sum("121-150"), sum("151-180"),sum( "181-210"),
       sum("211-240"), sum("241-270"), sum("271-300"), sum("301-330"), sum("331-365"), sum("Bir ilden artiq"),sum(uzadilmishdar),
sum(" 0 %"),sum(" 2 %"),sum(" 10 %"),sum(" 30 %"),sum(" 60 %"),sum(" 100 %"),sum(girov)
  FROM cm_pur where hdate=:dat and dat=:dat
  
  
  group by code,name, m_kodu,"Mulkiyyet novu", "Borcalanun sektoru",
       "Borcalanin faliyyeti", "Borcalanin faliyyet novu",kodu ,p_kodu,a_kodu ,VAL_NAME

datasets.name: Girov
datasets.sql:
select count(say)as say,DESCRIPTION,sum(rest)as qaliq,sum(GIROV) as GIROV,sum(qenaitbexsh) as qenaitbexsh,sum(nezaretalt) as  nezaretalt,
sum(meqsedli)as  meqsedli,sum(Tehlukeli) as  Tehlukeli,sum(umudsuz) as  umudsuz, sum(Tesnifata_daxil_edilmemish) as  Tesnifata_daxil_edilmemish
   
  FROM cm_girov  a

  where hdate=:dat and dat=:dat

  group by DESCRIPTION

datasets.name: adiyyat
datasets.sql:
select 'Ümumi'as d ,  nvl(count(id),0) fullcount, nvl(sum((select sum(trancheamount) from cm_tranches where creditid=p.id)),0) fulltrancve
   ,nvl(sum((select count(id) from cm_active_credits  where id=p.id and CURRENCY<>0 )),0) valcount,
    nvl(sum((select sum(trancheamount) from cm_tranches where creditid=p.id and creditid in (select id from cm_active_credits where id=p.id and CURRENCY<>0))),0) valtran
    from cm_active_credits p 
    where p.dateofconclusion between :bdat and :edat and p.usrgroup not in(84,85,104,105)
 union  all
  select 'adiyyatı olanlar'as d,  nvl(count(id),0) fullcount, nvl(sum((select sum(trancheamount) from cm_tranches where creditid=p.id)),0) fulltrancve
   ,nvl(sum((select count(id) from cm_active_credits  where id=p.id and CURRENCY<>0 )),0) valcount,
    nvl(sum((select sum(trancheamount) from cm_tranches where creditid=p.id and creditid in (select id from cm_active_credits where id=p.id and CURRENCY<>0))),0) valtran
    from cm_active_credits p where 
    p.boorowerid in( select id from smart.customers where PRINAD_KOD<>0)
   and p.dateofconclusion between :bdat and :edat and p.usrgroup not in(84,85,104,105)

datasets.name: OracleDataSet5
datasets.sql:
select p.id, p.boorowerid, b.name,((h.rest+h.duerest)+CM_COMMON.OutAccountRest_Get(ac.OUTGUARANTEEACCID))*op.ostat qaliq 
 ,r.percent||'%',h.pledgeprice*op.ostat pledgeprice,pl.description,ai.name from
smart.cm_active_credits p, 
smart.cm_guarantee g,
smart.cm_history h,
smart.cm_boorowerinfo b,
smart.cm_pledges pl,
smart.CM_RESERVE_TYPES r,
smart.cm_accounts ac,
smart.operkurs op,
smart.CM_AIM_CRED ai,
(select p.boorowerid as brid,sum(h.rest)+sum(h.duerest)as qaliq from smart.cm_active_credits p ,smart.cm_history h
 where 
 p.id=h.creditid and h.hdate =( select tek_dat from smart.sysdat) 
  group by p.boorowerid) cs
where
p.id=b.creditid and
p.id=g.creditid and p.aim_id=ai.id and
p.id=h.creditid and
g.pledgeid=pl.id and 
h.hdate =:dat and op.dat= :dat and p.currency=op.val_kod and
h.reserveid=r.id and ac.creditid=p.id and p.boorowerid=cs.brid 





order by p.boorowerid
